content.text:
Avi's in the other room, so I'll tell you myself. I clicked through and found the thing I'd heard of, the savings plan, "תכנית חיסכון", listed right next to the deposit, "פיקדון". But I only got the one-line explanation. I didn't see the page behind it, so I don't know yet what it costs or how it's taxed. I'll ask you, or the bank, before I believe more than that.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **Home page.** It said "מקור – להבין חיסכון והשקעה בישראל", which sounded right for me. Then I read "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי". So it isn't a bank or anyone I know, which made me a bit wary.
- **Right-hand box.** I saw "להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה" and clicked it. I didn't use the big form in the middle (דירה, חתונה, boxes with ₪).
- **"מדריך" page.** It starts with "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון". I took it slowly and understood about half.
- **"כסף שוטף וקצר".** Here I found what I wanted:
  - The plan: "חיסכון בבנק שאליו מפקידים סכומים מדי פעם, למשל כל חודש בהוראת קבע, לתקופה מוסכמת בריבית". So that's what the clerk sold me.
  - The deposit: "כסף שמפקידים בבנק לתקופה מוסכמת, ובתמורה הבנק משלם עליו ריבית".
- **Further down I skimmed.** I saw קרן השתלמות, פנסיה and the children's savings. The next screen was all מדד boxes: S&P 500, MSCI World, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35. That's shares, not for me, and that's where I stopped. The last screen was just black.

**What I didn't understand**
- On the first page: "מסלול או מונה" in the search box.
- "קרן כספית", "קרן כספית מתחדשת" and "מק"מ". They sat in the same row as my deposit, so I wasn't sure whether they're as safe.
- "צמודה", "קופון", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו".
- The English letters.

**What bothered me**
- The whole site is black with grey writing. The small grey lines were hard to read even enlarged: "בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה…", "המוצר עצמו: חשבון בבנק…" and the footer.
- The boxes are all the same shape and colour. I had to read every one to find mine.
- Nearly every index box repeats "הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". By the third one I was tired.
- The first page opens with a form full of ₪ boxes, not with deposits. I nearly didn't know where to start.

But I only got that one line. I didn't see the page behind it with the costs and tax, so I'll ask my son or the bank about the rest.
